title: Gempa, tsunami, dan likuefaksi Palu–Sigi–Donggala, 28 September 2018
status_note: Core event, BMKG parameters, BNPB impact and loss figures, and liquefaction/red-zone facts are supported by national media reporting official sources, each tied to its date. Not 'validated' yet: BNPB/BMKG primary documents not archived; casualty totals were revised over months (see real_facts).

regency_city_documented.evidence: Liquefaction at Petobo and Balaroa (Mongabay 2019-04-10); largest loss share Rp 8.3 T (Kontan/BNPB 2018-10-28)
Liquefaction at Jono Oge and Sibalaya (Mongabay); loss Rp 6.9 T (Kontan/BNPB)
Epicentre ~26 km north of Donggala (Detik/BMKG); loss Rp 2.7 T (Kontan/BNPB)

real_facts.fact: BMKG: magnitude 7.4 earthquake at 17:02:44 WIB on 28 Sep 2018, depth 11 km, about 26 km north of Donggala (initially reported as M7.7). A tsunami warning was issued with estimated arrival at Palu around 17:22 WIB; 22 aftershocks (M2.9–M6.3) by 20:00 WIB.

BNPB: total loss and damage Rp 18.48 trillion as of 27 Oct 2018 (losses Rp 2.89 T, damage Rp 15.58 T); by location Palu Rp 8.3 T, Sigi Rp 6.9 T, Donggala Rp 2.7 T, Parigi Moutong Rp 640 billion. Casualties at the same report: 2,086 dead, 1,309 missing, 4,438 injured, 206,524 displaced.

Liquefaction occurred at Petobo and Balaroa (Palu) and Jono Oge and Sibalaya (Sigi), among other sites. Petobo was designated a red zone considered uninhabitable, yet some residents returned, citing better access to clean water and sanitation than in evacuation sites.

Casualty figures were revised repeatedly after October 2018; later provincial totals (reported in academic/secondary sources) differ from BNPB's October figures. The game shows only dated BNPB figures.

root_causes_note: Geological causes of liquefaction are documented by Badan Geologi publications (geologi.esdm.go.id) found during search but not yet reviewed; not used in game text until reviewed.

fact_vs_simulation_notes: BMKG parameters, BNPB figures and the red-zone fact are real and dated. The player's options and every consequence are SIMULATED; the game does not claim what the real government chose.
